instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security

questions.question: Why did DevSecOps emerge as a framework?
options: Because cloud providers removed shared responsibility.
Because firewalls became too slow for web traffic.
Because agile and DevOps required security to keep pace.
Because auditors demanded a new certification.
options_ar: لأن مزوّدي السحابة أزالوا المسؤولية المشتركة.
لأن الجدارات صارت أبطأ من ترافيك الويب.
لأن agile و DevOps تطلّبا أمنًا يلحق بالوتيرة.
options_en: Because cloud providers removed shared responsibility.
Because firewalls became too slow for web traffic.
Because agile and DevOps required security to keep pace.
Because auditors demanded a new certification.
questions.explanation: The move to agile and DevOps forced a parallel evolution in security strategy, which is what DevSecOps is.
questions.explanation_ar: الانتقال إلى agile و DevOps فرض تطوّراً موازياً باستراتيجية الأمن، وهذا هو DevSecOps.

questions.question: What does DevSecOps embed?
options: Security testing and monitoring across the lifecycle.
A single penetration test before each release.
A firewall rule set reviewed once a quarter.
A separate security team outside the pipeline.
options_ar: اختبار الأمن والمراقبة عبر دورة الحياة كلها.
اختبار اختراق واحد قبل كل إصدار.
مجموعة قواعد جدار تُراجع مرة كل ربع.
فريق أمن منفصل خارج خط الإنتاج.
options_en: Security testing and monitoring across the lifecycle.
A single penetration test before each release.
A firewall rule set reviewed once a quarter.
A separate security team outside the pipeline.
questions.explanation: Security becomes part of development and deployment rather than something appended after them.
questions.explanation_ar: الأمن يصير جزءاً من التطوير والنشر بدل شي يُلحق بعدهما.

questions.question: What does it mean that DevSecOps makes security integral rather than peripheral?
questions.question_ar: شنو يعني إن DevSecOps يخلي الأمن جوهرياً مو محيطياً؟
options: Security is checked only when an incident occurs.
Security is built into every stage, not bolted on at the end.
Security is delegated to an external consultancy.
Security is documented but not enforced in code.
options_ar: الأمن يُفحص فقط لمّا تصير حادثة.
الأمن مبني بكل مرحلة، مو ملحوق بالآخر.
الأمن موثّق بس مو مفروض بالكود.
options_en: Security is checked only when an incident occurs.
Security is built into every stage, not bolted on at the end.
Security is delegated to an external consultancy.
Security is documented but not enforced in code.
questions.explanation: Peripheral security happens after the fact and at the end; integral security is a property of every stage.
questions.explanation_ar: الأمن المحيطي يصير بعد الحدث وبالآخر؛ والأمن الجوهري صفة كل مرحلة.

questions.question: What does automated static and dynamic analysis provide?
questions.question_ar: شنو يوفّره التحليل الآلي الساكن والديناميكي؟
options: Runtime blocking of attacks against production traffic.
Encryption of the build artefacts at rest.
Rollback of the last deployment on failure.
Continuous vulnerability identification before deployment.
options_ar: حجب فوري للهجمات على ترافيك الإنتاج.
تراجع عن آخر نشر عند الفشل.
تعرّف مستمر على الثغرات قبل النشر.
options_en: Runtime blocking of attacks against production traffic.
Encryption of the build artefacts at rest.
Rollback of the last deployment on failure.
Continuous vulnerability identification before deployment.
questions.explanation: Static analysis reads the code, dynamic analysis exercises the running build, and both run continuously rather than once.
questions.explanation_ar: التحليل الساكن يقرأ الكود، والديناميكي يشغّل البناء، والاثنان يعملان باستمرار مو مرة واحدة.

questions.question: What does infrastructure-as-code security protect?
questions.question_ar: شنو يؤمّنه أمن البنية التحتية ككود؟
options: The certificate authority private key.
The physical console of the server.
Deployment scripts and their configurations.
The runtime memory of the application.
options_en: The certificate authority private key.
The physical console of the server.
Deployment scripts and their configurations.
The runtime memory of the application.
questions.explanation: If the deployment definition is compromised, every environment it creates inherits the flaw, so the scripts themselves are code to secure.
questions.explanation_ar: لو انخترق تعريف النشر، فكل بيئة ينشئها ترث العيب، فالسكربتات نفسها كود لازم يُؤمَّن.

questions.question: What does continuous compliance automate?
options: Alignment with regulatory requirements.
Rotation of every credential in the estate.
Rollback of failed infrastructure changes.
Replication of data between regions.
options_en: Alignment with regulatory requirements.
Rotation of every credential in the estate.
Rollback of failed infrastructure changes.
Replication of data between regions.
questions.explanation: Instead of proving compliance once a year, the pipeline keeps checking that controls still match the regulation.
questions.explanation_ar: بدل إثبات الامتثال مرة بالسنة، الخط يظل يتحقّق إن الضوابط ما زالت مطابقة للتنظيم.

questions.question: What does red-teaming and threat simulation assess?
questions.question_ar: شنو تقيّمه الفرق الحمراء ومحاكاة التهديدات؟
options: The completeness of the test coverage.
Resilience against evolving adversarial tactics.
The accuracy of the vulnerability scanner.
The performance of the CI runner pool.
options_en: The completeness of the test coverage.
Resilience against evolving adversarial tactics.
The accuracy of the vulnerability scanner.
The performance of the CI runner pool.
questions.explanation: It is a strategic assessment of whether the defences still hold against an adversary who adapts, not a checklist of known issues.
questions.explanation_ar: هو تقييم استراتيجي لمدى صمود الدفاعات أمام خصم يتكيّف، مو قائمة تحقّق بمشاكل معروفة.

questions.question: Which four strategic components does DevSecOps include?
questions.question_ar: أي أربعة مكوّنات استراتيجية يضمّها DevSecOps؟
options: Firewalling, proxying, VPN and network segmentation.
Backup, replication, failover and disaster recovery.
Hiring, training, awareness and policy writing.
Automated analysis, IaC security, compliance and red-teaming.
options_ar: جدارات وبروكسيات و VPN وتقسيم شبكي.
نسخ احتياطي وتكرار وتجاوز فشل وتعافٍ.
تحليل آلي وأمن IaC وامتثال وفرق حمراء.
options_en: Firewalling, proxying, VPN and network segmentation.
Backup, replication, failover and disaster recovery.
Hiring, training, awareness and policy writing.
Automated analysis, IaC security, compliance and red-teaming.
questions.explanation: Automated static and dynamic analysis, infrastructure-as-code security, continuous compliance, and red-teaming with threat simulation.
questions.explanation_ar: التحليل الآلي الساكن والديناميكي، وأمن البنية التحتية ككود، والامتثال المستمر، والفرق الحمراء مع محاكاة التهديدات.

questions.question: How is the vulnerability count across DevSecOps iterations modelled?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُنمذَج عدد الثغرات عبر دورات DevSecOps؟
options: Previous count divided by removal, plus new arrivals.
Previous count plus removal, minus new arrivals.
Previous count times one minus removal, plus new arrivals.
Previous count times removal, minus new arrivals.
options_ar: العدد السابق × (واحد ناقص الإزالة)، زائد الجديد.
options_en: Previous count divided by removal, plus new arrivals.
Previous count plus removal, minus new arrivals.
Previous count times one minus removal, plus new arrivals.
Previous count times removal, minus new arrivals.
questions.explanation: What survives the current iteration is the remaining fraction of the old count, and the new arrivals are added on top.
questions.explanation_ar: اللي يبقى من الدورة الحالية هو الكسر الباقي من العدد القديم، والثغرات الجديدة تُضاف فوقه.

questions.question: What does the removal parameter represent?
options: The proportion of vulnerabilities eliminated.
The proportion of new vulnerabilities introduced.
The number of iterations completed so far.
The average severity of the remaining flaws.
options_en: The proportion of vulnerabilities eliminated.
The proportion of new vulnerabilities introduced.
The number of iterations completed so far.
The average severity of the remaining flaws.
questions.explanation: It is the fraction the DevSecOps practices actually remove during one iteration.
questions.explanation_ar: هي الكسر اللي تزيله ممارسات DevSecOps فعلاً خلال دورة واحدة.

questions.question: What does the arrival parameter represent?
options: The cost of remediating a single flaw.
New vulnerabilities introduced during the iteration.
Vulnerabilities carried over from the previous one.
The number of layers in the pipeline.
options_en: The cost of remediating a single flaw.
New vulnerabilities introduced during the iteration.
Vulnerabilities carried over from the previous one.
The number of layers in the pipeline.
questions.explanation: Development keeps producing new code, and new code keeps producing new flaws, so the model has to admit inflow.
questions.explanation_ar: التطوير يظل ينتج كوداً جديداً، والكود الجديد يظل ينتج عيوباً، فالنموذج لازم يعترف بالتدفق الداخل.

questions.question: Under what condition is the DevSecOps strategy effective?
questions.question_ar: بأي شرط تكون استراتيجية DevSecOps فعّالة؟
options: When new arrivals exceed removal divided by the count.
When removal equals new arrivals exactly, every iteration.
When the count stays constant across all iterations.
When removal exceeds new arrivals divided by the count.
options_ar: لمّا يتجاوز الجديد الإزالة مقسومة على العدد.
لمّا تتساوى الإزالة والجديد بالضبط كل دورة.
لمّا يبقى العدد ثابتاً عبر كل الدورات.
لمّا تتجاوز الإزالة الجديد مقسوماً على العدد.
options_en: When new arrivals exceed removal divided by the count.
When removal equals new arrivals exactly, every iteration.
When the count stays constant across all iterations.
When removal exceeds new arrivals divided by the count.
questions.explanation: The threshold is relative to the current count, so a small estate needs a higher removal rate than a large one to keep falling.
questions.explanation_ar: العتبة نسبية للعدد الحالي، فمؤسسة صغيرة تحتاج نسبة إزالة أعلى من كبيرة حتى تستمر بالنزول.

questions.question: What does that condition mean in plain terms?
questions.question_ar: شنو يعني ذلك الشرط بعبارة واضحة؟
options: The scanner must be replaced every iteration.
The count must be reset to zero each cycle.
Removal has to outpace the new flaws at that size.
The team must stop writing any new code at all.
options_ar: الإزالة لازم تسبق العيوب الجديدة بذلك الحجم.
الفريق لازم يوقف كتابة أي كود جديد.
options_en: The scanner must be replaced every iteration.
The count must be reset to zero each cycle.
Removal has to outpace the new flaws at that size.
The team must stop writing any new code at all.
questions.explanation: It is a race between how fast you fix and how fast you add, and the ratio to the current backlog decides who wins.
questions.explanation_ar: هي سباق بين سرعة الإصلاح وسرعة الإضافة، ونسبة كل منهما للمخزون الحالي تحدّد من يفوز.

questions.question: What does a declining trajectory of residual vulnerabilities indicate?
questions.question_ar: شنو يدلّ عليه مسار هابط للثغرات المتبقية؟
options: The strategy removes faster than it introduces.
The team has stopped deploying any changes.
The scanner has stopped finding anything new.
The backlog is being ignored deliberately.
options_ar: الفريق توقّف عن نشر أي تغييرات.
الفاحص توقّف عن إيجاد أي جديد.
options_en: The strategy removes faster than it introduces.
The team has stopped deploying any changes.
The scanner has stopped finding anything new.
The backlog is being ignored deliberately.
questions.explanation: Successive iterations leave fewer behind, which is the operational meaning of the effectiveness condition being met.
questions.explanation_ar: الدورات المتعاقبة تترك أقل، وهذا هو المعنى العملي لتحقّق شرط الفاعلية.

questions.question: What happens if the removal proportion is zero?
questions.question_ar: شنو يصير لو كانت نسبة الإزالة صفراً؟
options: The count becomes undefined immediately.
The count only grows, so the strategy has failed.
The count stays fixed at the initial value.
The count falls slowly but steadily.
options_ar: العدد يبقى ثابتاً عند القيمة الأولى.
options_en: The count becomes undefined immediately.
The count only grows, so the strategy has failed.
The count stays fixed at the initial value.
The count falls slowly but steadily.
questions.explanation: With nothing removed and something always added, the recurrence reduces to repeated addition, which is the opposite of a security programme.
questions.explanation_ar: بلا إزالة ومع إضافة دائمة، التكرارية تختزل لجمع متكرّر، وهذا عكس برنامج أمني.

questions.question: What does a large arrival term require of the removal rate?
questions.question_ar: شنو يشترط معامل وصول كبير من نسبة الإزالة؟
options: Nothing extra, since the terms are independent.
A smaller removal rate, to avoid over-correcting.
A reset of the iteration counter to zero.
A proportionally larger removal rate to keep falling.
options_ar: لا شي إضافي، لأن الحدود مستقلة.
نسبة إزالة أصغر، لتجنّب التصحيح الزائد.
نسبة إزالة أكبر بالتناسب حتى يستمر النزول.
options_en: Nothing extra, since the terms are independent.
A smaller removal rate, to avoid over-correcting.
A reset of the iteration counter to zero.
A proportionally larger removal rate to keep falling.
questions.explanation: Because the condition compares removal against arrivals relative to the current count, a higher inflow raises the bar for what counts as effective.
questions.explanation_ar: بما إن الشرط يقارن الإزالة بالجديد نسبةً للعدد الحالي، فتدفق أعلى يرفع العتبة اللي يعتبر فعّالاً.

questions.question: How does DevSecOps differ from a periodic security audit?
questions.question_ar: كيف يختلف DevSecOps عن تدقيق أمني دوري؟
options: It removes the need for penetration testing.
It is performed only by external consultants.
It runs continuously inside the pipeline, not once a year.
It replaces the need for any security policy.
options_ar: يشتغل باستمرار داخل الخط، مو مرة بالسنة.
options_en: It removes the need for penetration testing.
It is performed only by external consultants.
It runs continuously inside the pipeline, not once a year.
It replaces the need for any security policy.
questions.explanation: An audit samples a moment; a pipeline checks every change, which is why the feedback arrives while the change is still cheap to fix.
questions.explanation_ar: التدقيق يعاين لحظة؛ والخط يفحص كل تغيير، ولهذا توصل التغذية الراجعة والتغيير لا يزال رخيص الإصلاح.

questions.question: How does DevSecOps relate to the shift-left principle?
questions.question_ar: كيف يرتبط DevSecOps بمبدأ الانزياح يساراً؟
options: It is the operational form of shifting security left.
It contradicts shift-left by adding later gates.
It applies shift-left only to infrastructure code.
It replaces shift-left with periodic scanning.
options_ar: هو الصيغة التشغيلية لانزياح الأمن يساراً.
يناقض الانزياح يساراً بإضافة بوابات متأخرة.
يطبّق الانزياح على كود البنية فقط.
options_en: It is the operational form of shifting security left.
It contradicts shift-left by adding later gates.
It applies shift-left only to infrastructure code.
It replaces shift-left with periodic scanning.
questions.explanation: Shift-left is the principle and DevSecOps is how it is actually implemented in an agile delivery pipeline.
questions.explanation_ar: الانزياح يساراً هو المبدأ، و DevSecOps هو كيف يُنفَّذ فعلاً بخط تسليم رشيق.
